global: {player} switched colors and expected nobody to notice. Everyone noticed.
Some folks trade their banner for a warmer hearth. Enjoy the new roof, {player}.
Back in the first war, deserters got a rope. Today they get a long memory.
{faction} may welcome a turncoat, but they will count every shield you carry.
Loyalty is a small coin, {player}. Some of us still keep ours in a tight purse.
Still waiting for {player} to explain the ride over to {faction}. I have time, and a long memory.
whisper: {player}, you left {my_faction} at the gate and walked off smiling. Don't expect a warm welcome next time.
Heard you are wearing {faction}'s colors now. Wear them well, because we will remember this face.
Every deserter thinks the grass is greener. Mostly it is just more mud, {player}.
You know what the old hands say about turncoats? They make poor company in a siege.
No hard feelings? I'd say plenty of hard feelings. Keep your distance from our walls.
Your name is still on our rolls, {player}. We haven't crossed it out yet, and we won't forget why.

global: {player} moved to {faction} this week. Fine. Let's see how long the coin lasts.
Plenty of people change banners. The ones who last are the ones who stay put.
Saw {player}'s new tabard at the crossroads. Hope the cloth is warmer than our hall was.
Doors open both ways here. Just don't be surprised when people remember which way you walked.
The fens don't care what color you fly, {my_faction} included. Mind your footing, {player}.
Switching flags is allowed on this server. Whether it's wise is a question I'll leave to time.
whisper: {player}, you're free to choose your flag. I'd just ask you to think about who you stand beside.
Your choice to join {faction} is your own. Don't ask me to pretend I'm not disappointed, though.
Think it through before you pledge fully. Half-hearted oaths are the ones that break in a siege.
If {faction} treats you well, good for you. If not, our gates remain, for now.
Some turn coats for a better purse, others for a better cause. Which one are you, {player}?
I won't hold a grudge over a banner. I will remember how you handled the parting, though.

global: {player} took the road to {faction}. We'll miss the steady hand, but no grudges from me.
Shame to lose {player} from our ranks. Still, a good soldier is a good soldier wherever they stand.
Parting ways with {player} stings a bit. The old hall will still have a seat for them.
Don't let anyone tell you that leaving was dishonest, {player}. It was a hard choice, and you made it openly.
Remember the first war? We learned that friends sometimes wear different colors and still hold the line.
Good luck to {player} over at {faction}. Honor the oaths you make there, and we'll cheer you on.
whisper: {player}, I'm sorry to see you go, but I understand the reasons. Come find me if you need advice.
You always carried yourself well in our ranks. I expect the same standard under {faction}'s banner.
No hard feelings from this old hand. You earned your place with honest work, and that won't vanish.
If {faction} asks too much of you, come back and talk. Our door doesn't lock on friends.
Leaving was a bold move, {player}. Make sure it was the right one, and then give it everything.
I'll be watching the next big battle, {player}. Fight like you did for us, and you'll be fine. :)
